description: This test file verifies the functionality of thread binding persona resolution functions defined in 'thread-bindings.persona.js'. It includes tests for label precedence, fallback behavior, and constructing persona from a record.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingPersona
methods.description: Resolves a persona string based on the provided thread binding data, preferring labels and falling back on agentId.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingPersonaFromRecord
methods.description: Constructs a persona string from a ThreadBindingRecord object, prefixed with a gear icon.
